entities.summary: Dina Porat is the academic advisor and former chief historian of Yad Vashem, Professor Emerita in the Department of Jewish History at Tel Aviv University, where she also served as head of the Kantor Center for the Study of Contemporary European Jewry, and as holder of the Alfred P. Slaner Chair for the Study of Antisemitism and Racism.
